Burnham told the House of Commons he would try to "repair bridges" between Kyiv and Washington. Zelenskyy is due to travel next to a summit of European leaders in Brussels.
items.bullet_summary_preload:
- **Volodymyr Zelenskyy** told Piers Morgan Uncensored on Wednesday that he feels betrayed by **Donald Trump** and that Ukraine is losing a strong partner, Reuters reported[1].
- Trump announced a Russian diesel deal with **Vladimir Putin** on Oct. 9, said Zelenskyy should be replaced, then announced an energy truce Oct. 11[2].
- Zelenskyy blamed Trump's advisers and called the shift "not the right side of history." He also warned that new **Starlink** restrictions will cost lives[6].
